help:
Usage: aidd [options] [command]

Generate AI coding assistant configurations from the AIDD framework

Options:
  -V, --version          Show version number
  --verbose              Show detailed diagnostic output (default: false)
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]        Set up or update the project to a correct state
  framework              Framework build and management tools
  ai                     Manage AI tools (claude, cursor, copilot, codex,
                         opencode)
  ide                    Manage IDE integrations (vscode)
  plugin                 Manage plugins for AI tools
  marketplace            Manage plugin marketplaces
  auth                   Manage authentication
  status                 Show drift across all installed tools and plugins
  restore [options]      Restore tracked files to their installed version (from
                         manifest hashes)
  update [options]       Re-install runtime configs, update plugins, and refresh
                         marketplaces
  doctor                 Check installation health and detect issues across all
                         tools and plugins
  clean [options]        Remove all AIDD-managed files from the project
  self-update [options]  Update the aidd CLI to the latest version
  help [command]         display help for command

Usage: aidd ai [options] [command]

Manage AI tools (claude, cursor, copilot, codex, opencode)

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  install [options] <tool>      Install an AI tool runtime configuration from
                                bundled assets
  uninstall <tool>              Remove an AI tool's generated configuration
                                files
  list                          List installed AI tools
  status [options]              Show drift for AI tools (optionally filtered by
                                tool and/or plugin)
  update [options] [tool]       Re-install AI tool configs from bundled CLI
                                assets
  restore [options] [files...]  Restore AI tool tracked files to their installed
                                version
  doctor [options]              Check AI tool installation health (optionally
                                filtered by plugin)

Usage: aidd ai doctor [options]

Check AI tool installation health (optionally filtered by plugin)

Options:
  --plugin <name>  Limit doctor to a specific plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd ai install [options] <tool>

Install an AI tool runtime configuration from bundled assets

Options:
  -f, --force   Overwrite already-installed tool (default: false)
  --no-plugins  Skip propagation of already-installed plugins onto the new tool
  -h, --help    display help for command

Usage: aidd ai list [options]

List installed AI tools

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ai restore [options] [files...]

Restore AI tool tracked files to their installed version

Options:
  -f, --force      Restore without prompting (default: false)
  --tool <tool>    Limit restore to a specific AI tool
  --plugin <name>  Limit restore to a specific plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd ai status [options]

Show drift for AI tools (optionally filtered by tool and/or plugin)

Options:
  --tool <tool>    Limit status to a specific AI tool
  --plugin <name>  Limit status to a specific plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd ai uninstall [options] <tool>

Remove an AI tool's generated configuration files

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ai update [options] [tool]

Re-install AI tool configs from bundled CLI assets

Options:
  -f, --force  Overwrite modified files without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: aidd auth [options] [command]

Manage authentication

Options:
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]  Authenticate with GitHub
  logout           Remove stored authentication
  status           Show authentication status

Usage: aidd auth login [options]

Authenticate with GitHub

Options:
  --gh                    Use GitHub CLI token (default: false)
  --token <value>         Personal access token
  --level <user|project>  Storage level (user or project)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd auth logout [options]

Remove stored authentication

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd auth status [options]

Show authentication status

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd clean [options]

Remove all AIDD-managed files from the project

Options:
  --force     Confirm file removal (skip dry-run) (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd doctor [options]

Check installation health and detect issues across all tools and plugins

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd framework [options] [command]

Framework build and management tools

Options:
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  build [options]  Build a Claude-format framework into a target-native plugin
                   marketplace tree or project workspace
  help [command]   display help for command

Usage: aidd framework build [options]

Build a Claude-format framework into a target-native plugin marketplace tree or
project workspace

Options:
  --source <path>    Path to the source framework directory
  --target <target>  Build target (claude, cursor, copilot, codex, opencode)
  --out <dir>        Output directory (marketplace dist or project root)
  --flat             Materialize directly into project workspace, bypass
                     marketplace
  --force            Overwrite existing files at canonical paths (flat mode
                     only)
  -h, --help         display help for command

Usage: aidd ide [options] [command]

Manage IDE integrations (vscode)

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  install [options] <tool>      Install an IDE integration from bundled assets
  uninstall <tool>              Remove an IDE tool from the manifest
  list                          List installed IDE tools
  status                        Show drift for IDE tools
  update [options] [tool]       Re-install IDE tool configs from bundled CLI
                                assets
  restore [options] [files...]  Restore IDE tool tracked files to their
                                installed version
  doctor                        Check IDE tool installation health and detect
                                issues

Usage: aidd ide doctor [options]

Check IDE tool installation health and detect issues

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ide install [options] <tool>

Install an IDE integration from bundled assets

Options:
  -f, --force  Overwrite already-installed tool (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: aidd ide list [options]

List installed IDE tools

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ide restore [options] [files...]

Restore IDE tool tracked files to their installed version

Options:
  -f, --force    Restore without prompting (default: false)
  --tool <tool>  Limit restore to a specific IDE tool
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: aidd ide status [options]

Show drift for IDE tools

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ide uninstall [options] <tool>

Remove an IDE tool from the manifest

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd ide update [options] [tool]

Re-install IDE tool configs from bundled CLI assets

Options:
  -f, --force  Overwrite modified files without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace [options] [command]

Manage plugin marketplaces

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] [name] [source]  Register a plugin marketplace
  list [options]                 List registered plugin marketplaces
  remove [options] <name>        Remove a registered plugin marketplace
  refresh [options] [name]       Refresh registered marketplaces
  check                          Report stale marketplaces and upstream-removed
                                 plugins

Usage: aidd marketplace add [options] [name] [source]

Register a plugin marketplace

Options:
  --scope <user|project>  Registration scope (default: project) (default:
                          "project")
  --yes                   Skip the trust + cleanup prompts
  --overwrite             Replace an existing marketplace with the same name
  --token <value>         Auth token (host detected from source URL at fetch
                          time)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace check [options]

Report stale marketplaces and upstream-removed plugins

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace list [options]

List registered plugin marketplaces

Options:
  --plugins   Also fetch and print all plugins from each marketplace catalog
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace refresh [options] [name]

Refresh registered marketplaces

Options:
  --force     Clear cache before re-fetching
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd marketplace remove [options] <name>

Remove a registered plugin marketplace

Options:
  --yes       Skip the orphan-cleanup prompt
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin [options] [command]

Manage plugins for AI tools

Options:
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  create [options] [name]     Scaffold a new plugin in the given output
                              directory
  remove [options] <name>     Remove a plugin from one or all AI tools
  list [options]              List installed plugins for one or all AI tools
  install [options] [plugin]  Install a plugin (marketplace name, local path, or
                              interactive pick)
  search [options] <query>    Search registered marketplaces for plugins
  update [options] [name]     Update one or all plugins for one or all AI tools
  doctor [options]            Check plugin installation health

Usage: aidd plugin create [options] [name]

Scaffold a new plugin in the given output directory

Options:
  --output <dir>  Output directory (default: current directory)
  --type <kind>   Plugin type: full, skills, agents, hooks, mcp (default: full)
  --force         Overwrite existing directory
  --yes           Skip all interactive prompts (CI mode)
  -h, --help      display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin doctor [options]

Check plugin installation health

Options:
  --plugin <name>  Filter check to one plugin
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin install [options] [plugin]

Install a plugin (marketplace name, local path, or interactive pick)

Options:
  --from <market>         Marketplace name (when multiple match)
  --tool <toolId>         Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  --token <value>         Auth token (host detected from source URL at fetch
                          time)
  --scope <user|project>  Install scope; must match the tool's supported scope
  --yes                   Auto-resolve interactive prompts (CI mode)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin list [options]

List installed plugins for one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin remove [options] <name>

Remove a plugin from one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin search [options] <query>

Search registered marketplaces for plugins

Options:
  --recommended         Show only recommended plugins
  --marketplace <name>  Limit to a single marketplace
  -h, --help            display help for command

Usage: aidd plugin update [options] [name]

Update one or all plugins for one or all AI tools

Options:
  --tool <toolId>  Target AI tool (default: all installed)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: aidd restore [options]

Restore tracked files to their installed version (from manifest hashes)

Options:
  -f, --force  Restore without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: aidd self-update [options]

Update the aidd CLI to the latest version

Options:
  --check      Check if a newer version is available without installing
               (default: false)
  --dry-run    Preview the update without installing (default: false)
  -f, --force  Reinstall even if already up to date (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: aidd setup [options]

Set up or update the project to a correct state

Options:
  --source <mode>           Framework source: remote or local
  --path <dir>              Absolute path to local framework (required with
                            --source local)
  --release <tag>           Marketplace release tag to fetch (e.g., v1.2.3)
  --ai <ids>                Comma-separated AI tool IDs, or 'all' (e.g.,
                            claude,cursor or all)
  --ide <ids>               Comma-separated IDE tool IDs, or 'all' (e.g., vscode
                            or all)
  --plugins <mode>          Plugin install mode: none | all | recommended |
                            comma-separated names
  --no-default-marketplace  Skip auto-registering aidd-framework (no source
                            prompt, no plugin install)
  --yes                     Accept defaults without prompting
  -h, --help                display help for command

Usage: aidd status [options]

Show drift across all installed tools and plugins

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: aidd update [options]

Re-install runtime configs, update plugins, and refresh marketplaces

Options:
  -f, --force  Overwrite modified files without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help   display help for command
